description: Stratified sample of 30 emails from seed data for classification testing. Uses AI classifier's real taxonomy: client | insurance | spam. Single run per email = 30 AI calls total.
note: Seed data contains no spam examples - spam class untested

emails.subject: Need to reschedule Thursday appointment
emails.body: Hi, I need to move my appointment scheduled for this Thursday at 2pm. I have a work conflict. Can we do Friday morning instead? I'm flexible between 9am-11am. Thanks!

emails.subject: Appointment availability next week?
emails.body: Hello, I'm a current patient and would like to book my next session. Do you have any openings next Tuesday or Wednesday afternoon? Preferably after 3pm. Please let me know what times work. Thank you.

emails.subject: Confirm appointment for July 8th
emails.body: Just wanted to confirm my appointment for Monday July 8th at 10:30am. Is this still on your calendar? I'll plan to arrive 10 minutes early for paperwork. See you then.

emails.subject: Cancel and rebook appointment
emails.body: I need to cancel my Friday appointment due to a family emergency. Can we reschedule for sometime next week? I'm available Monday, Wednesday or Thursday mornings. Sorry for the short notice.

emails.subject: Follow-up appointment booking
emails.body: Dr. Song asked me to schedule a follow-up in 2 weeks. I'd like to book something around the same time as my last visit - Tuesday afternoon around 2-3pm if possible. Let me know what's available. Thanks!

emails.subject: Running 15 minutes late for today's appointment
emails.body: Hi, I'm stuck in traffic and will be about 15 minutes late for my 2pm appointment today. So sorry! Should I still come or do we need to reschedule? Please let me know ASAP. Thanks for understanding.

emails.subject: New patient - requesting initial consultation
emails.body: Hello, I was referred by Dr. Kim and would like to schedule an initial consultation for lower back pain. I'm available most weekday afternoons. What's your next available new patient slot? I have Blue Cross insurance. Thank you.

emails.subject: Requesting earlier appointment time
emails.body: I have an appointment next Thursday at 4pm but was hoping to come in earlier that day if possible. Do you have any cancellations or openings between 10am-1pm? I'm flexible on the exact time. Let me know, thanks!

Please maintain accurate attendance logs for all eight currently booked sessions. Let us know if you require any additional electronic document links.

emails.subject: Initial Acupuncture Intake Form for Chronic Lower Back Pain
emails.body:
My name is Alice Vance and I am seeking holistic treatment options. For the past six months, I have suffered from constant, dull lower back discomfort. Sitting at my office desk for long periods exacerbates this painful condition significantly. I would like to schedule an initial consultation and evaluation next week.

Your clinic came highly recommended by a close colleague of mine. I am hoping acupuncture can help manage my symptoms without heavy medication. Please let me know what specific documentation is required before my visit. I am generally flexible on Tuesday and Thursday afternoons for appointments.

emails.subject: Patient Follow Up for Alice Vance After First Treatment Session
emails.body:
Dear Dr. Huy, I wanted to share my feedback after yesterday's session. My lower back felt surprisingly light and relaxed immediately after the treatment. However, I noticed a slight bruising sensation around the lumbar insertion points today. Is it normal to experience mild soreness twenty-four hours later?

I drank plenty of water and avoided strenuous physical activities as instructed. The deep muscle tension has definitely decreased compared to last week's baseline. I am scheduled for another appointment this coming Friday at two o'clock. Thank you for your exceptional care and attentive treatment during my visit.

emails.subject: Patient Intake Request for Persistent Shoulder Stiffness and Pain
emails.body:
My name is Bob Miller and I need assistance with joint stiffness. My right shoulder has restricted mobility following an intensive weightlifting injury last month. I experience sharp pain whenever I attempt to lift my arm overhead. Massage therapy provided temporary comfort but failed to resolve the core issue.

I am eager to try acupuncture to reduce inflammation and restore mobility. Can you accommodate a new patient intake session early next week? I want to explore a comprehensive recovery protocol with Dr. Huy directly. Let me know what administrative details you require to confirm my booking.

emails.subject: New Client Onboarding for Digestive Health and Chronic Bloating
emails.body:
My name is Charlie Davis and I struggle with digestive issues. For over a year, I have dealt with severe bloating and discomfort. Conventional gastrointestinal treatments have failed to produce any meaningful, lasting improvements. I want to explore how acupuncture can regulate my digestive system function.

I would like to arrange an intake appointment with Dr. Huy. Please let me know your earliest availability for a comprehensive diagnostic consultation. Are there specific dietary records I should bring to my first visit? Thank you for guiding me through the clinic onboarding process today.

emails.subject: Patient Intake Inquiry for Severe Sciatica and Radiating Leg Pain
emails.body:
My name is Diana Textor and I require urgent pain relief. I am experiencing severe sciatica that shoots pain down my left leg. The discomfort becomes unbearable when standing or walking for over ten minutes. My neurologist recommended acupuncture as an excellent complementary therapeutic option for me.

I would love to schedule an intake appointment with Dr. Huy. Do you have any openings available this Thursday morning for new clients? Please let me know what steps are necessary to initiate my care. I am eager to find a solution for this debilitating leg discomfort.

emails.subject: Coverage Verification — James Mitchell / AET-2024-003

emails.subject: PI Report Request — David Rivera / MVA May 15, 2024
emails.body: Dear Dr. Song, I am representing Mr. David Rivera (DOB 9/12/1953, Cigna member CIG-2024-005) in a personal injury case. He was involved in a motor vehicle accident on May 15, 2024 (rear-end collision). Please prepare a comprehensive PI report documenting his injuries, treatment, prognosis, and functional limitations. The report should include: date and type of accident, chief complaint, examination findings, diagnosis codes, treatment plan with frequency and duration, prognosis, and current functional limitations. Claim reference: MVA-2024-0515-DR. Please submit to this email when complete. Thank you.
